mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.2% triggers a preemptive equity risk premium as investors anticipate future rate hikes, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.2% in the current month
failure_condition: Over a 60-day window, the 20-day forward return is not statistically higher than the 5-day prior average (t-test p > 0.05), or inflation reverts below 0.2% within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in PAYEMS labor cost index exceeding 0.5% signals wage pressures that outpace productivity, prompting a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days as profit expectations rise.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return mean is not statistically above the 20-day baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during the wage acceleration regime, or productivity index (INDPRO) grows faster than labor costs over the same horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in RSAFS retail sales of more than 5% followed by a rebound above the prior month's low predicts a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days as market anticipates stabilization in consumer demand.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls >5% for 2 consecutive months, then rises above prior month's low in the third month
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in >70% of similar recovery episodes (rolling window of 12), or the rebound in RSAFS is not accompanied by a positive 5-day SPX move.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in INDPRO manufacturing index below 90 for two consecutive months, while HOUST industrial production remains flat, predicts a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days as supply-side constraints weigh on equity valuations.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 90 for 2 consecutive months AND HOUST >= previous month's value
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in >60% of analogous supply-constrained episodes (rolling IC > 0.25), or both INDPRO and HOUST show sustained upward momentum over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 2.5% for 4 consecutive months, absent a coincident rise in UNRATE, predicts a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 days as investors anticipate slower credit expansion.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 2.5% for 4 consecutive months AND UNRATE remains flat or rises <0.1% over the same period
regime_hint: low-rate plateau without labor cost pressure
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return mean is not statistically lower than the 20-day prior mean (t-test p > 0.05) during such plateaus, or UNRATE rises >0.2% while FEDFUNDS stays suppressed.

mechanism_narrative: A one-time monthly spike in PAYEMS exceeding +1.0% followed by a sustained UNRATE decline below 4.5% for 10 days predicts a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 days as job market tightness eases and wage growth is expected to moderate.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >1.0% in the current month AND UNRATE falls below 4.5% within the next 10 trading days
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is not positive in >80% of similar cooling episodes (rolling IC > 0.35), or wage growth (PAYEMS) does not decelerate alongside falling unemployment (implied by UNRATE).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly rise in GDPC1 personal consumption exceeding 2% for 3 months, without a corresponding increase in CPIAUCSL inflation, predicts a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days as demand growth is interpreted as sustainable.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases by >2% for 3 consecutive months AND CPIAUCSL increases by <0.3% over the same period
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is not statistically higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during such episodes, or inflation accelerates while consumption growth remains strong.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in both INDPRO and GDPC1 below their 2020 pandemic lows for 4 consecutive months predicts a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 days as persistent supply disruptions depress equity risk premia.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 2020 pandemic low AND GDPC1 < 2020 pandemic low for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return mean is not significantly below the 20-day prior mean (t-test p > 0.05) during such episodes, or both indices show meaningful recovery (>2% increase) within 90 days.
